recommendations.problem: Deployed 90% of capital, only $1028 cash left
recommendations.solution: Implement Kelly Criterion with max 5% per position, maintain 40% cash reserve
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce max loss per position from ~$950 to ~$500, keep capital for opportunities

recommendations.problem: 0 positions closed in entire test period, 0% win rate
recommendations.solution: Add time-based exits (close after 48h if <5% gain), trailing stops, tighter thresholds
recommendations.expected_impact: Generate actual realized P&L, improve win rate from 0% to 40-60%

recommendations.solution: Track conditionId of open positions, skip markets already in portfolio

recommendations.problem: Simple volume/liquidity/price scoring with 50% threshold lets bad trades through
recommendations.solution: Add: time-to-expiry score, price momentum (compare to 24h ago), min volume $50k, confidence >= 70%
recommendations.expected_impact: Filter out 60% of bad trades, focus on higher-conviction opportunities

recommendations.problem: Average entry $0.260 - buying extreme long-shots that rarely pay
recommendations.solution: Narrow price range to 0.20-0.80, prefer 0.30-0.70 for better risk/reward
recommendations.expected_impact: Higher probability of profit, smaller position sizes needed

recommendations.problem: No minimum cash reserve, bot can deploy 100% of capital
recommendations.solution: Enforce 40% minimum cash reserve, scale position size with available capital
recommendations.expected_impact: Always have capital for new opportunities and dip buying

recommendations.problem: SentimentAnalyzer exists but is never used in trading decisions
recommendations.solution: Integrate sentiment signals as additional confidence factor
recommendations.expected_impact: Additional edge from market sentiment, +5-10% better signal quality

recommendations.problem: Max drawdown reported as 0.02% but actual is 71%
recommendations.solution: Track portfolio value every cycle, implement circuit breakers at 20% drawdown
recommendations.expected_impact: Stop trading during adverse conditions, preserve capital

recommendations.problem: No sector/category awareness, could load up on correlated markets
recommendations.solution: Max 2 positions per market category, spread across political/sports/crypto/economics
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce correlation risk, smoother equity curve
